author: groundxero
title: Amid Ongoing Siang Protests, In-Principle Forest Clearance Nod to Naying Hydroelectric Project; Over One Lakh Trees to Be Felled
content:
The recommendation for in-principle forest clearance for the 1,000-MW Naying Hydroelectric Project in Arunachal Pradesh comes amid escalating protests against large dam projects in the Siang river basin.

With 470.8 hectares of forest land set to be diverted, compensatory afforestation proposed 1,700 kilometres away in Madhya Pradesh, and landowners rejecting NEEPCO’s compensation offer, the

Naying

project on the Siyom River raises serious questions about ecological destruction, and the social cost of hydropower expansion

in a region where indigenous communities are increasingly resisting such projects that threaten their forests, rivers and ancestral lands.


 


Groundxero


Desk


 


Amid growing opposition and resistance to the proposed 11,200-MW Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) in Arunachal Pradesh, another major hydroelectric project in the Siang river basin has moved closer to implementation. On October 23, 2026, the Forest Advisory Committee (FAC) of the Union Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

recommended in-principle forest clearance

 for the 1,000-MW Naying Hydroelectric Project on the Siyom River (Yomgo River), a major tributary of the Siang.


 


The FAC recommendation permits the diversion of 470.8 hectares of unclassed forest land for the project, which will require the felling of approximately 1,04,036 trees. The FAC has categorised the project area as a “high conservation value zone”. The clearance comes despite persistent objections from project-affected communities, unresolved disputes over land compensation and allegations of procedural irregularities in the environmental clearance process.


 


The Naying project, being developed by the North Eastern Electric Power Corporation (NEEPCO), is a run-of-the-river scheme with peaking power generation capability. Proposed on the Siyom (Yomgo) River, a right-bank tributary of the Brahmaputra, the project extends across parts of Shi-Yomi and Siang districts, both bordering China. With an estimated investment of Rs 11,835 crore, it involves the construction of a 108-metre-high concrete gravity dam over an area of approximately 470 hectares.


 


The project was conceived more than a decade ago and received the Central Electricity Authority’s concurrence in 2013. Its progress remained stalled for years because of environmental and social concerns, particularly the large-scale diversion of forest land. The Union Environment Ministry’s Expert Appraisal Committee recommended environmental clearance in June 2026, and the project received conditional environmental clearance in July. The conditions included safeguards relating to compensatory afforestation, wildlife conservation, air and noise pollution monitoring, and waste management. A mandatory public hearing was subsequently held at Yapik village in Shi-Yomi district.


 


Construction is expected to begin around 2028, with commissioning targeted for 2032.


 


Landowners reject NEEPCO’s compensation offer


 


The successive clearance procedures of the project have intensified opposition among affected landowners. Twelve villages are expected to be affected, and grievances over compensation have developed into a major source of conflict between local communities and NEEPCO.


 


The dispute reached a deadlock in September 2026, when NEEPCO proposed compensation of just Rs 130 per square metre for land and forest resources during an administrative meeting in Yapik village. The Naying Hydroelectric Project Land Owner Welfare Committee (NHEPLOWC), led by its chairman, Taya Yabu, rejected the offer, describing it as a gross undervaluation of ancestral land.


 


The landowners pointed out that compensation rates for comparable infrastructure projects in other districts of Arunachal Pradesh ranged between Rs 3,000 and Rs 5,000 per square metre. They demanded that the same standard be applied to the Naying project.


 


On September 23, landowners from seven affected villages met at Yapik and formally decided to suspend all cooperation with NEEPCO until their demands concerning compensation and land rights were addressed.


 


The nine-point memorandum submitted by the Land Owner Welfare Committee also raised objections to unauthorised tree cutting and clear-felling within designated local forest areas without the required final clearances and compliance procedures.


 


Questions over the environmental public hearing


 


The landowners’ opposition is not confined to …

author: David Greene
title: EFF Submission to OHCHR Consultation on Child Rights and Safety in the Digital Environment
content:
“

The safety of young people in the digital environment cannot be assessed without also considering the safety of young people in offline environments. For millions of young people around the world, the digital environment is their safe place, their haven from an unsafe physical environment, community, or family situation. The digital environment may be the best, perhaps only, place for them to find critical safety information and community, to explore ideas that are controversial in their families and larger physical environments, and to otherwise nourish their personal autonomy.


“For these young people, regulatory efforts that limit their access to online services or to certain features they find valuable, make their lives, in total, less safe, even if there has been some marginal safety benefit to their digital environment.


“The OHCHR must thus consider the whole of young persons' lives in any recommendations that come out of this process and not treat ‘safety, physical or mental health, and rights in the digital environment’ as disconnected from safety, physical or mental health, and rights elsewhere.”


So begins

EFF’s submission

 to the global Call for Inputs on

Child Rights and Safety in the Digital Environment

 conducted by the United Nations Office of the High Commissioner on Human Rights. The OHCHR is preparing a report on the issue to be presented to the UN Human Rights Council at its 64th session in the first quarter of 2027. The Human Rights Council requested the OHCHR to solicit input from a wide range of stakeholders, including child and youth perspectives, and convene five regional consultations to assess the risks to the safety of the child in the digital environment and best practices to address these risks in different geographical areas, bearing in mind current and emerging business models. 


The OHCHR acknowledges that young people today navigate a digital environment with both “unprecedented opportunities” and “serious and evolving risks,” and sets out a rights-based framing whereby “Children's 'safety' is therefore addressed through the full framework of their rights — with freedom from violence (Art. 19) and protection from exploitation and abuse (Arts. 34–36) as clearly defined obligations, situated alongside privacy (Art. 16), access to information (Arts. 13 and 17), expression (Art. 13), participation (Art. 12), and development (Art. 6). Protection and the full range of children's rights are understood as reinforcing rather than competing imperatives, and measures taken in the name of safety must not be used to restrict the enjoyment of other rights, such as the right to privacy and the right to participate.”


In light of this, EFF’s

submission

 focused on the current general disregard for young people's speech and privacy rights by regulators around the world, all of whom seem far more interested in empowering parents rather than young people themselves, or meaningfully involving young people in the regulatory process. 

We emphasized the human rights-centered uses young people make of social media that were not specifically set out in the concept note. 

We also explained that too often, policy proposals aiming to remedy the issues of online safety for young people introduce limitations on access to online services and content rather than tackling the specific problems that people experience. 


More specifically, our submission looks at:


the most significant risks to young people’s safety in the digital environment


how digital product design and business models drive risks to children's rights online, including in AI-mediated services


the inclusion of young people’s views in the design, governance, and regulation of digital environments 


how equality and non-discrimination in access and protection can be ensured


the promotion of digital literacy, skills, and empowerment for young people 


the impact of legislative and regulatory measures from the United States to Indonesia and Australia 


importance of broader, more systemic interventions that can address address online harms


how global instruments and processes can protect young people online. 


The internet is where young people learn, find community, explore their identities, access important information, and express themselves. Curtailing these opportunities doesn't make them safer. And requiring everyone to hand over sensitive personal information just to access online spaces creates privacy risks for …

author: Brian Hioe
title: May Chin Indictment Gestures Toward Extensive Reach of Chinese United Front Work
content:
INDEPENDENT PAN-BLUE legislator Kao Chin Su Mei, also known as May Chin or Ciwas Ali, and who is an Indigenous legislator of the Atayal people, has been indicted for Chinese United Front work. According to prosecutors, Chin accepted more than 170 million NTD, which was funneled to organizations, relatives, and other bodies in order to conduct influence operations aimed at winning elections. Prosecutors are seeking 14 years for Chin, who was previously facing charges about illegally importing Chinese COVID-19 vaccines for distribution among her constituents.

The networks of these organizations were managed by her office director, Chang Chun-chieh, and legislative assistants Chen Chih-huang and Lin Yi-chun. Chang is currently under investigation for having fled overseas by boat in order to avoid arrest, with authorities conducting raids earlier this month to find the vessel on which he escaped. Chang and Chen reportedly coordinated United Front efforts, while Lin acted as an intermediary with China. Chin has been accused of using her influence as a legislator in order to influence government policy in arms sales, defense, cross-strait relations, and international relations.

For her part, Chin has denied participation in such United Front work, suggesting that she did not need Chinese support to win elections. Chin also raised questions about why she was apparently under surveillance for two decades before authorities acted on it, instead framing charges against her as politically motivated persecution by the Lai administration.

Rumors about Chin’s involvement in United Front efforts targeting Indigenous communities have been longstanding. China has long directed United Front outreach toward Indigenous communities, with the hopes that they will vote pan-Blue, as has often historically been the case. Such United Front outreach also aims to show Indigenous communities the benefits of unification with China, often by touting the supposed benefits that ethnic minority communities receive in China.

If Chin has finally been targeted by authorities, it is to be seen to what extent the KMT rallies behind her. Though Chin is a pan-Blue independent, she caucuses with the KMT and is generally understood to act in concert with the party. But it is possible that prosecutors will also take action on cases of other pan-Blue legislators who receive support from China. One notes that KMT legislative caucus leader Fu Kun-chi has faced charges of receiving campaign merchandise to be distributed among potential voters that was supplied by China. As Fu’s political network is rooted in Indigenous-heavy Hualien, it is possible that there are further ties to Chinese United Front work by him or other KMT politicians.

At the same time, it is also to be seen how the general public understands prosecution against Chin or other KMT legislators. Certainly, the public was willing to accept prosecution against former Taipei mayor Ko Wen-je on corruption charges, as well as other pan-Blue figures who have faced corruption charges, such as former Yilan magistrate Lin Zi-miao. But it remains to be seen whether they accept the validity of charges against Chin and other pan-Blue legislators implicated in United Front activity.

author: Darío Aranda
title: La salud no es lo primero: en Argentina se utilizan 167 agrotóxicos prohibidos en otros países
content:
Por Javier Souza Casadinho*


Los plaguicidas autorizados en Argentina que están prohibidos o no autorizados en otros países alcanzan la cifra de 167 productos, y 35 de ellos son Plaguicidas Altamente Peligrosos (PAP) según los criterios establecidos por la FAO (organismo de Naciones Unidas para la agricultura y la alimentación) y la Organización Mundial de la Salud (OMS). Entre las

empresas responsables sobresalen


Syngenta, Bayer, Adama, Corteva y Atanor

. En Argentina, cada año, su utilizan 580 millones de litros de venenos del agro.


Incremento en el uso de plaguicidas


El

modelo productivo agrícola en la Argentina

 ha experimentado una profunda transformación en las últimas décadas, caracterizada por la expansión de la frontera agropecuaria y la adopción consolidada de paquetes tecnológicos dependientes de fertilizantes sintéticos y agroquímicos, mal denominados "fitosanitarios".


En este contexto cobran especial relevancia los Plaguicidas Altamente Peligrosos (PAP). En Argentina, la problemática adquiere dimensiones críticas debido a los volúmenes de aplicación y a la cercanía de las zonas de cultivo con núcleos poblacionales. Los casos más frecuentes y documentados de exposición e impacto ambiental, que en ocasiones derivan en

demandas judiciales

, involucran a principios activos de amplio uso

como el glifosato, el paraquat, la atrazina, el 2,4-D y la cipermetrina

.


Lejos de limitarse a un único sector, estas sustancias se emplean de manera intensiva y extensiva en distintas matrices productivas que configuran el mapa productivo del país, abarcando

desde la agricultura extensiva de cereales y oleaginosas hasta economí

as regionales como el cultivo de tabaco y la horticultura

. Un informe del Instituto Nacional de Tecnología Agropecuaria (INTA) señala que “la Argentina se caracteriza por tener un importante consumo anual de productos fitosanitarios, los cuales son de origen nacional por síntesis o formulación y muchos son importados. En los 36 millones de hectáreas cultivadas,

se utilizan 230 millones de litros de herbicidas y 350 millones de litros de otros productos

 fitosanitarios”.


Una comparación entre la superficie sembrada de cereales y oleaginosas y el consumo de plaguicidas desde 1990 hasta la actualidad muestra que el aumento en el uso de plaguicidas ha sido muy superior al incremento en la superficie cultivada. En las últimas tres décadas, la superficie sembrada con cereales y oleaginosas creció de 19.000.000 de hectáreas en 1990 a 41.182.000 hectáreas en 2023, lo que representa un aumento del 117 por ciento. En el mismo período, la producción pasó de 38.200.000 toneladas a 140.893.000 toneladas, un incremento del 269 por ciento.


Entre 1990 y 2022, el uso de plaguicidas en Argentina se incrementó de manera exponencial: pasó de 35 millones a 580 millones de kg/litros, lo que representa un aumento del 1.657 por ciento.


Existen diversos factores de índole económica, productiva y ambiental que pueden incidir en el incremento en la utilización de plaguicidas tales como: aumento de las especies de hierbas resistentes a herbicidas, mayor presión de los patógenos (hongos y bacterias)

,

 incremento en la superficie agrícola de alimentos y de biocombustibles, baja de aranceles a la importación de determinados principios activos precursores de plaguicidas, reducción en el precio de ingredientes activos cuyas patentes han caducado, alta demanda de insumos por parte de la horticultura y fruticultura para mantener la calidad formal de los productos, el

cambio climático

 junto a modificaciones en las legislaciones que regulan el registro, uso y comercialización de estos insumos.


Foto: Nicolás Mendiola – Greenpeace


Los Plaguicidas Altamente Peligrosos (PAP)


Según el Código de Conducta sobre Manejo de Plaguicidas (adoptado por la FAO y la OMS en 2013) y de las Guías sobre PAP, los Plaguicidas Altamente Peligrosos pueden definirse como:


Los que presentan niveles particularmente altos de peligro agudo o crónico para la salud o el ambiente, conforme a los sistemas de clasificación aceptados a nivel internacional, como los de la OMS o del SGA (Sistema Globalmente Armonizado).


Por estar incluidos en acuerdos o convenios jurídicamente vinculantes.


Aquellos que aparecen como causantes de daño grave o irreversible a la salud humana o al ambiente, en las condiciones de uso en un país, pueden ser considerados y tratados como altamente peligrosos.


Desde la

Red Internacional de Acción …

author: Unknown
title: Ejército Zapatista de Liberación Nacional - Don’t Forsake Us!
content:
Author

: Ejército Zapatista de Liberación Nacional

Title

: Don’t Forsake Us!

Subtitle

: Zapatista Women in ’94

Date

: 1994

Notes

: Originally published by Ediciones OnA, València-Chiapas: 1

st

 edition May 2018, 2

nd

 edition January 2019, 3

rd

 edition July 2019, 4

th

 edition January 2020.

 English translation by Ediciones Bloodfruit/Malvivientes, 2026.

Source

: Retrieved 10/30/26 from https://www.patreon.com/bloodfruit/posts/dont-forsake-us-173797846


 The money raised from the this first volume are going to the benefit of Compañera M. Mother,

 Social Warrior, Multiply Employed, Indigenous.


 The best way to understand the path of the women who struggle is through their own words. These brief texts, interviews and declarations of the women of the Zapatista Army for National Liberation in the first months of the armed uprising of 1994 showcase the situation of indigenous women in Mexican territory, and are a mirror of the dignity that has kept the Zapatista struggle alive despite male chauvinism, racism and capitalism.


 This edition was part of a mutual aid initiative to redistribute the

funds of the circulating texts and “Independent” editions among

the struggles’ female protagonists


Words From Comandanta Ramona and Major Ana María


Another concern that indigenous

women have is the free choice of partners.


“The dowry custom still exists,

the girl is never taken into account,

she is sold off (in this region,

the average price of nuptial dowry is

two thousand pesos). The idea of

having a boyfriend doesn’t exist; it is sin.”


 Ana María, Infantry Major: “Don’t Forsake Us!” is the desperate plea of the women of the Zapatista Army for National Liberation so that their hopes of being heard within and without their communities may not die. “We ask all women to fight alongside us” is what Comandanta Ramona and Major Ana María say in Tzotzil and Spanish. Their call to Mexican women is not one to take up arms, but rather so that, within their spaces, they may support the changes proposed by the Revolutionary Law of Women, as well as their extensive list over equality, justice, health, education and housing. That night, the penultimate they would spend at the Cathedral, they arrived through the back of the altar, accompanied by Subcomandante Marcos.


 He, dressed in his unmistakable military uniform. Some steps behind, the only two women of a group of the 19 delegates of the Indigenous Clandestine Revolutionary Committee. “I’ll leave them with you so that you can speak to them about anything you wish,” he said in a joking tone as he bid his farewell to the group of five female reporters and two photographers intent on interviewing the women of the Zapatista Army. Ramona’s wide and sharp eyes revealed weariness. The black wool skirt, the beautifully embroidered loom-woven blouse, and her short stature contrasted with Ana María’s gray

ruana

 and sturdy frame. Alongside them, Comandante Javier remained behind (to translate Ramona’s Tzotzil’s words into Spanish). The words of the Comandanta, even if in Tzotzil, flow smoothly from her indigenous heart.


 I left my community in search of work because of necessity itself, there was no longer anything to live off of. When I arrived someplace else I began to learn that it wasn’t the same situation as that of women in the countryside. I learned there to understand and gain conscience of the differences, that’s how I learned of the organization (EZLN), and that it was also necessary to organize women.


 Within EZLN women’s participation in key. Ramona belongs to the political group that works in the communities; Ana María is part of the approximately 30% of female combatants/insurgents who voluntarily refuse to form a family in order to engage in armed struggle.


 “I am an insurgent. I’ve dedicated my entire life and time to the cause,” affirms Ana María, a 26 year old Infantry Major who, when speaking of displacement and suffering endured, furrows her brows in sadness, the only sign of expression able to be seen beneath her balaclava. “It’s a long story,” she says,


 Ever since I was eight years old I took part in peaceful struggles, in marches, in meetings. My family was one that fought, that always organized in order to have a dignified life, but that never achieved it through that route. We were in an organization —won’t say which— with other persons, with other peoples. We would go there, the children too, and that’s how we went began …

author: daniel
title: Ableistisches journalistisches Versagen
content: Dieser wurde aber weitgehend totgeschwiegen. Es gab kaum Presseberichte. Selbst über die Besetzung eines Bundesministeriums berichtete einzig die Frankfurter Rundschau. Journalist*innen schreiben lieber über Einzelschicksale. Mitleid-erweckende Berichte generieren online Klicks und gefallen Leser*innen. Die Berichte bleiben oberflächlich und die systemischen und politischen Hintergründe werden nicht beleuchtet. Betroffene als Objekte einer bequemen Berichtserstattung. Sobald Betroffene als Akteur*innen auftreten und das System, das sie behindert, anprangern, werden sie unsichtbar gemacht. Die Redaktionen stehen offenbar zu dieser ableistischen Linie. Der Lüneburger Behindertenbeirat kritisierte die Nicht-Berichtserstattung der Landeszeitung (LZ) über eine Kundgebung am europäischen Protesttag für die Gleichstellung von Menschen mit Behinderung. Die Redaktion antwortete am 22. Mai 2026 wie folgt: „Anm. d. Red.: Am Protesttag selbst hat die LZ tatsächlich nicht berichtet. Wir stellen hingegen regelmäßig Schicksale von Menschen mit Einschränkungen in den Mittelpunkt von Geschichten – unabhängig von Protest- oder Gedenktagen. So haben wir beispielsweise am 9. Mai von der 16-jährigen Lotti berichtet, die trotz Unterstützungsbedarf ihren Traumberuf lernen will.“ Selbst die verwendete Sprache ist hier ableistisch. Das Wort „Behinderung“ wird gemieden, obwohl dies kein Schimpfwort ist, sondern eine neutrale Eigenschaft. Das ist ein journalistisches Versagen. Die Graswurzelrevolution wird dagegen über die Proteste und ihre Hintergründe ausführlich in der GWR 514 berichten. Seid auf den Schwerpunkt der Dezemberausgabe gespannt!

author: Sarah Hughes
title: Members Alarmed by End-Run around Democracy at Buffalo Health Care Local
content:
Things had been tense for some time inside the leadership of Communications Workers (CWA) Local 1168, a 4,800-member health care union based near Buffalo, New York. Still, it was a high-functioning local with a busy calendar of events, stewards handling grievances, organizers pursuing leads, and leaders organizing at work.


So it was a surprise to members in June when their parent union, CWA, put the local into trusteeship, at the request of the local’s president and seven of the nineteen executive board members.


Trusteeship meant the union’s bylaws and elected leaders were suspended, and most of its work temporarily ground to a halt. The appointed Director of Organizing and Mobilizing Mary Nowocien and elected Vice President Patrick Weisansal II found themselves locked out of their group chats, email, and union hall, and facing an internal union prosecution.


A staffer of CWA District 1, Erin Spaulding, was assigned as trustee—tasked with maintaining the functioning of the local, setting up and overseeing judicial processes for the charges against officers, and making a plan to return the union to local control.


Nowocien and Weisansal saw the sudden trusteeship as an escalation of a long-running conflict and a deliberate undermining of the upcoming union elections. Weisansal had just announced his intention to run against incumbent President Cori Gambini.


Now the elections are on hold until the trials are over, whenever that is. And lately, the employer has been taking advantage of the turmoil in the union.


While the allegations are serious, members are concerned that the trusteeship was a nuclear option for an internal financial matter and that it has torn apart relationships at the local, weakened opposition to management’s schemes and denied democratic processes to an active, engaged union membership.


ALLEGED TIMECARD ISSUES


The trusteeship filing lists the cause as “serious allegations of financial misconduct” from officers and “dueling charges” between leaders.


Gambini and Executive Vice President Robert Andruszko had accused Nowocien and Weisansal of defrauding the local of thousands of dollars, by getting paid by both the union and their employer for the same hours worked, and by falsifying records. These issues came to light during a timecard audit in the fall of 2025 by their employer, Kaleida Health.


Nowocien and Weisansal acknowledged there were significant errors on old timecards and paychecks, but said it was the product of the employer’s faulty timekeeping and payroll system, and human error. The majority of other officers also had issues, they pointed out, but only some were being singled out for discipline by the local and the employer.


Spaulding, the trustee, interviewed all the suspended officers and allowed the majority to return to their paid positions—with the exception of Nowocien, Weisansal, and three others not facing any charges: the Communications and Political Directors and one of the Area Vice Presidents. Also fired were two longtime staff organizers, on the grounds that there was no work for them to do, according to one, Ann Converso, who had recently helped organize a new unit of substance use disorder counselors and was gearing up for their first contract fight.


Many current leaders on both sides of this schism were part of a reform caucus in Local 1168, the Caucus of Rank-and-File Healthcare Employees (CORHE), which dissolved when they won their positions in 2020.


Since winning, Gambini and a few others have butted heads with Weisansal, Nowocien, and others over how to tackle problems. The latter camp frequently organized their facility—Buffalo General Hospital, the union’s largest unit—to push back against management’s changes and violations. Gambini and leaders aligned with her argued that that wasn’t the right approach—that they had to pick their fights and not overextend the membership, according to Weisansal.


One Buffalo General steward, who asked to not be named, said members were appalled that the trustee had removed elected officers. “If our employer treated one of our members in a similar fashion,” the steward said, “union leadership would rally around them and fight to return them to their position!”


Spaulding wrote in a public FAQ posted on the local’s social media that the temporary administration “is not intended to be punitive or find guilt against any individual in the Local. It is intended to stabilize the Local while issues are …

author: Tam Saavedra
title: WEI and UN Women Co-Launches Guide for Disability-Inclusive
content:
Across Asia and the Pacific, 350 million women and girls with disabilities navigate conflict, crisis, and climate instability. While they are frontline peacebuilders, community leaders, and human rights defenders, they remain systematically excluded from formal peace and security decision-making.

To break down these barriers, Women Enabled International (WEI) and the UN Women Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific have officially launched a landmark publication today: the Guidance Note on Disability-Inclusive National Action Plans on Women, Peace and Security in Asia and the Pacific. Released ahead of the annual UN Security Council high-level debate in New York, this first-of-its-kind guide provides a practical, policy-oriented blueprint for governments, policymakers, and civil society.

Read the full Guidance Note on Disability-Inclusive NAPs on WPS in Asia and the Pacific

Historically, women with disabilities in peace policies have been viewed narrowly as victims or passive recipients of protection. Co-drafted through consultations with 26 women and gender-diverse people with disabilities, in collaboration with Women Enabled International and the UN Women Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific, this guide directly challenges that narrative. It grounds its framework in a human rights model of disability and the core movement principle: “Nothing about us without us”.

As WEI Executive Director Maryangel García-Ramos Guadiana stated during the launch:

“The true value of this Guidance Note is that it exists, not as a siloed document, but as a means to ensure we, as feminist disabled change-makers, are not left out of the agenda, but we are the ones who get to set the agenda.”

UN Women Regional Director for Asia and the Pacific, Christine Arab, added:

“National Action Plans on WPS that include everyone lead to peace that lasts.”

The publication was shaped by participatory research, drawing on focus groups and surveys with 26 grassroots leaders with diverse disabilities across the region. It addresses critical ground-level hurdles—including digital exclusion, inaccessible evacuation infrastructure, and ableism in mainstream spaces—ensuring that the voices of women, girls and gender-diverse people with disabilities form the foundation of the guidance.

The publication urges stakeholders to align National Action Plans (NAPs) with international standards—including the CRPD, CEDAW, and UN Security Council Resolution 2475—across all four WPS pillars:

Participation: Reserve seats for organizations of persons with disabilities (OPDs)—especially women-led OPDs—on NAP steering committees with full accessibility support.

Participation: Reserve seats for organizations of persons with disabilities (OPDs)—especially women-led OPDs—on NAP steering committees with full accessibility support.

Prevention: Recognize women and gender-diverse people with disabilities as active peacebuilders and integrate intersectional early-warning indicators.

Prevention: Recognize women and gender-diverse people with disabilities as active peacebuilders and integrate intersectional early-warning indicators.

Protection: Address unique forms of violence (such as caregiver abuse or institutionalization) and guarantee accessible shelters and evacuation procedures.

Protection: Address unique forms of violence (such as caregiver abuse or institutionalization) and guarantee accessible shelters and evacuation procedures.

Relief & Recovery: Ensure transitional justice mechanisms, reparations, and post-conflict upskilling actively include women with disabilities.

Relief & Recovery: Ensure transitional justice mechanisms, reparations, and post-conflict upskilling actively include women with disabilities.

The guide also features a practical Disability-Inclusive WPS NAP Checklist to help stakeholders evaluate progress at every stage of policy implementation.

This Guidance Note was made possible with the generous support of the Government of the Republic of Korea (through the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family) as part of the project “Promoting Leadership of Future Generation Peacebuilders and Change-makers in Asia and the Pacific”, and of the Australian Government under the Regional Framework Towards Peaceful, Inclusive Societies (2023–2027).

title: La menace de l'auto-justice
content:
Au lendemain du 17 octobre, le garde des sceaux Gérald Darmanin, brandie le menace de milices d'auto-défense : « si la réponse pénale aux violences liées au 17 octobre n'est pas extrêmement ferme », alors « les commerçants et les habitants feront justice eux-mêmes ». Une semaine plus tard, le 24, des milices fascistes sous-couvert de défense des petits commerçants attaquent des manifestations dans plusieurs villes de France. De nombreuses vidéos diffusées sur les réseaux sociaux attestent d'une collusion voir d'une collaboration avec les forces de l'ordre. author: Peter C. Gøtzsche, MD
title: Winning Norwegian Lawsuits about Forced Drugging with Antipsychotics
content:
I

t is very difficult to win lawsuits about psychiatric malpractice, particularly about forced drugging with antipsychotics.

1

 One reason is, as lawyer Jim Gottstein, has observed in Alaska,

2

 and which I have also seen on several occasions, that psychiatrists routinely misrepresent the evidence in court: About how ill their patients are; what wonders they can achieve with antipsychotics; and saying that the patients have tolerated them well, which the patients disagree with.

3


When I studied 30 consecutive cases from Denmark

3

 and 30 consecutive cases from Alaska,

4

 where the patients had appealed forced treatment orders, I found that the legal procedures were a sham where the patients were defenceless, and that the law had been violated in every single case.


Another reason why lawsuits are difficult to win is that judges have so much respect for authority that they didn’t care the least when I, other expert witnesses, and lawyers for the plaintiffs like Gottstein demonstrated in court that professors of psychiatry and other experts were lying.

1,2,5


A third reason why it is so difficult to obtain justice is that Ombudsman and Supreme Court decisions are consistently being ignored.

1

 In Norway, the Ombudsman concluded in 2018 that forced treatment with an antipsychotic in a concrete case had violated the law.

6

 The law stipulates that forced drugging can be used when, with “high probability, it can lead to recovery or significant improvement in the patient’s condition, or if the patient avoids a significant worsening of the disease.” Referring to science, the Ombudsman noted that the probability of achieving the intended improvement is very low.


Despite the Ombudsman’s ruling, the unethical practice just continued. It is therefore very significant, also in an international context, that four court cases in Norway—three of them related to antipsychotics—were recently won.


In 2024, I was an expert witness in a lawsuit against the Norwegian State at the Oslo District Court.

5

 It was lost because of an incompetent judge, but the Court of Appeal, which corresponds to the Superior Court in other countries, ruled in 2026 that the human rights were violated when Inger-Mari Eidsvik was subjected to forced treatment with antipsychotics and in a case of solitary confinement.


It had been very difficult to get there. Inger-Mari’s lawyers had been fighting

pro bono

 for over three years for the right to sue the state for multiple violations of the European Convention on Human Rights, the UN conventions, and the Norwegian Constitution. After having lost in two inferior courts, they won at the Supreme Court and were allowed to go ahead with the first case ever to challenge coercive treatment in psychiatry.


I describe here three other Norwegian cases. I met the three women involved at the Mad in Norway film festival in September 2026 where my filmmaker and I showed our documentary, “The Illusion of Psychiatry.”

7

 My account is based on court documents and personal information.


Helen Wesnes


Helen’s story is so gruesome that it is hard to believe that this could happen in a civilised country. She was sexually assaulted in her late teens and struggled with insomnia and nightmares. In the end, she agreed to a two-week stay at a psychiatric hospital, which a psychologist had suggested.


Two weeks turned into nine years. Helen spent nine years continuously in Reinsvoll Hospital from 2000 when she was only 20 years old. NINE YEARS!


Then, from 2009 to 2015, she stayed at an assisted living residence where she was subjected to forced medication. In total, she was under forced treatment for 15 years.


From day one, she was put on an antidepressant, and shortly thereafter she also received antipsychotics, benzodiazepines, an antiepileptic, a stimulant, and lithium. She was misdiagnosed with hebephrenic schizophrenia, but lithium doesn’t work for schizophrenia.

8,9

 It was also medical malpractice to treat Helen with Leponex (clozapine) and Abilify (aripiprazole) simultaneously. National

10

 and international guidelines recommend against using two antipsychotics at the same time and there are very good reasons for this. The benefit is not increased by increasing the dose

11

 but the risk of death from these highly toxic drugs is of course dose-related.

12


Leponex is a particularly toxic drug, which is not more effective than other antipsychotics,

title: Dress code Halloween
content:
Le 31 octobre, c'est Halloween – la fête des morts. Généralement ils reviennent exiger des bonbons ou des sorts. Le 17 octobre, le gouvernement a choisi les sorts. Résultat : on vient de quitter l'époque contemporaine et, depuis, Bismillah, c'est les ténèbres. Mais ces ténèbres, elles sont super drôles.


Jamais autant de créatures multiformes n'avaient déferlé dans nos insurrections. Il nous a fallu analyser cet étrange phénomène. Alors on a invité deux experts des ténèbres joyeuses : le philosophe Norman Ajari et l'essayiste Pacôme Thiellement. La brèche entre les mondes vient de s'ouvrir, elle n'est pas près de se refermer. C'est la première fois que la révolution s'apparente à la chorégraphie du Thriller de Michaël Jackson. Si le Gilet Jaune de 2018 s'est ajouté au k-way noir de 2016, désormais : c'est l'intégralité du multiverse qui se fait costume. Il n'est pas certain que, dans cette immense Battle d'aura avec le gouvernement, ce soient la police qui ait le meilleur déguisement. Joyeux Halloween.

author: Anne-Marie Cicala
title: How My Body Rejected Lithium After 25 Years
content:
It was two o’clock in the morning on our first night out of town in New Orleans, and I woke up suddenly in the dark hotel room feeling horribly sick and needing to run to the bathroom. What ensued was messy and lasted for two hours. I kept waking up with my head in the toilet to do it again. I used most of the towels in the bathroom to clean up both myself and the mess I had made on the floor. At 4am, exhausted and beyond tired, not knowing exactly how to handle the situation, I opened my hotel room door completely naked, threw the armful of soiled towels into the hallway and went back to bed.

The next morning, I woke up extremely nauseous. I was thankful we had packed a decent amount of THC gummies, as they proved to be a savior for the next few days. The gummies took the nausea down to a level where I was able to function throughout the day, but I was still not feeling right or well. I didn’t know if it was from the previous night’s events, but I felt subdued by a heavy brain fog.

The day progressed slowly, as I was not feeling 100%, but I made it through, enduring other would just get a good night’s sleep and be better in the morning. Yet, without fail, I once more woke up in the middle of the night, more prepared this time, and got sick several times.

I really had no idea what was going on. Once again, I woke up with severe nausea but thought maybe a good breakfast would set me straight.

At the hotel restaurant, I could not tolerate the smell of the food. I could barely drink my coffee. My husband, looking at me searchingly, kept asking if I was okay. I tried to assure him that I would be fine, although I wasn’t sure I believed that myself. He finally said, “I don’t know what to do when my wife looks like she’s about to vomit at any moment.” Remembering how much the gummies had helped me the day before, I decided it was going to have to be another day like that, so I asked him to go up to the room to retrieve one for me. He happily obliged. I ate the gummy and was feeling relief within about 40 minutes. I could finally breathe and begin to perform as a person on vacation.

At restaurants, I noticed that the menus would shake furiously in my hands, as well as my fork and my drinking glass. I brushed it off as my usual lithium tremor combined with low blood sugar. I also noticed that my thirst was unquenchable. At one restaurant, as soon as the waiter set the water on the table, I chugged the glass immediately and instructed him to keep them coming, that I was extra thirsty. My husband looked at me with concern and kept the gummies coming, which were still keeping the nausea at a manageable level. My additional stomach ailments continued, but I pushed through them and tried to make the best of it, still under the spell of a heavy brain fog.

After another night of vomiting and immediately popping gummies as soon as I woke up, my husband and I put our heads together. We ran through the list of symptoms I had been experiencing, coming up clueless. Next, we thought back on anything that had changed recently. Aha! Indeed, my psychiatrist had increased my lithium right before we left for vacation.

Only knowing that connection, we began to research my symptoms plus the keyword ‘lithium’. Immediately, tons of links popped up about lithium toxicity, something neither one of us knew anything about. It seemed serious, but some of the stories I read seemed a lot graver than mine, so I figured I wasn’t in need of emergency care. I simply discontinued the lithium, and we went home the next day. Not getting back until later in the evening, it was the following day before I could go in for an emergency blood draw to check my lithium levels, something that had been done frequently throughout my nearly 25-year history of being on the medication.

I had been put on lithium for my early bipolar (then later schizoaffective) diagnosis when I was 18 years old, after spending the previous year psychiatrically hospitalized seven times for depression, anxiety, psychosis and unstable mood. I was promised mood stability and less suicidal ideation. It was supposedly the leading option, my best line of defense. That is what I was told for the next 25 years, but I was never told about lithium toxicity.

From the start, the side effects were horrible. So much GI distress and unquenchable thirst, which I know now was my kidneys urgently trying to rid my body of the essential poison of the drug. I learned to deal with it. Every now and then …

Must We Lie to Please the Critics?

Social Conditions and Character.

Anarchists, Wise and Otherwise.

We find ourselves in a world of conflicting ideas, and every person who has individuality enough developed to be more, in human life, than a domestic animal or lifeless machine, must align himself with others who hold the same opinions, whether he will or not, and then he is in the view of others, and perhaps in his own view, labeled with the name of the idea he holds. So we find that nearly every person is labeled, and some persons have a number of labels.

Finding that we must be something—must hold to certain ideas and work for certain ends—if we work at all, or amount to any more in human life than an ox, or an ax, it very naturally follows that we will adopt and work for the prevalence of such ideas as will bring us the greatest happiness, now or bye and bye. That is why I am an Anarchist. I am convinced that to work for the realization of the Anarchist ideal will bring me more satisfaction than an adherence to, or working for, any other ideal would bring me.

But every one should be able and willing to give a reason for the “faith that is within him,” and I will try and do so.

I find myself in a world of sunshine and shade; of joy and sorrow; of happiness and woe. All around me I see fellow beings; beings that are constituted very much as I am, have similar desires, hopes and aspirations. I find that they are constantly trying to gratify these desires; to realize their hopes and attain to that for which they aspire. I find further that they can do these things only by exploiting inorganic nature, and by assisting each other. I find that as things are now, these beings instead of mutually assisting each other are constantly striving to injure each other, not because they take delight in the suffering of a fellow, but because they see no other way of satisfying their desires and aspirations. They think this state of affairs wrong, and are constantly clamoring for a change, but have not yet learned the great fundamental fact of human solidarity—of our interdependence.

Long have the various members of the human family sought to adjust themselves to environment, and of late have begun to endeavor to adjust the environment to suit themselves. All mankind craves for freedom, but most of the people have sought to gain freedom by subjugating others, or by restricting all alike. They have not learned that they cannot be free while they are holding others, or while they seek to restrict the freedom of others. No one desires to be injured, and yet no one can be secure from injury as long as he injures others. We all wish to be free from injury. I crave for freedom. I see that others want the same condition, and I know that my freedom can be made secure only by the freedom of all others. I know of no other ideal but Anarchy that, if really would secure freedom to me and to all others, therefore I am an Anarchist.

Es ist kaum 65 Jahre her, da war es absolut üblich, in der anarchistischen Literatur Analysen der Institutionen zu lesen, in denen sich die verschiedenen Formen der Herrschaft manifestierten. Wenn man beispielsweise über die Unterdrückung der Frauen schrieb, dann wurden die Familie und die Ehe untersucht und bloßgestellt. Wenn die Unterdrückung von Vergnügen und der Freude des Lebens zur Diskussion stand, dann wurden Religion und Gesetz ins Visier genommen. Der institutionelle Rahmen, in dem sich diese Gesellschaft abspielt wurde als Quelle der Ausbeutung, Herrschaft und Entfremdung wahrgenommen.

Es scheint so, als wäre dieser institutionelle Rahmen in jüngerer Zeit größtenteils vergessen worden zu sein. Von den verschiedenen Institutionen, in die unser entfremdetes kreatives Potenzial zu unserem Nachteil akkumuliert wurde, scheinen nur noch der Staat und das Kapital (und gelegentlich die Technologie) in einem bedeutenden Ausmaß Erwähnung zu finden und selbst diese werden häufig mehr als Geisteszustände, denn als konkrete soziale Institutionen behandelt. So entdecken wir beispielsweise, dass Anarchist*innen gegen Staatlichkeit (was auch immer das sein soll) sind, anstatt gegen den Staat. Auf diese Weise kann etwa ein Bookchin behaupten, gegen Staatlichkeit zu sein, während er den altertümlichen griechischen Stadt-Staat als Modell für seine demokratisierte Version der „Anarchie“ bewirbt.

Jede andere Form der Unterdrückung wird ebenfalls zu einem „-ismus“ (Rassismus, Sexismus, usw.) oder schlimmerem (Homophobie impliziert beispielsweise eine psychologische Störung, die einer Behandlung bedarf, anstatt einer sozialen Repression, die nach Revolte verlangt). Natürlich verleugnen wir nicht die Realitäten der Ideologien der Bigotterie und ihrer Durchdringung der Gedanken und Gefühle der Ausgebeuteten und Unterdrückten. Aber ohne ein Verständnis des institutionellen Rahmens der Unterdrückung und Herrschaft ist es nicht möglich zu verstehen, wie die herrschende Klasse diese Ideologien dazu nutzt, diejenigen zu spalten, die sie ausbeutet.

Selbst die anscheinend Radikalsten (weil ihre Rhetorik am extremsten ist) innerhalb des anarchistischen Millieus entgehen dem nicht. Die von primitivistischen und antizivilisatorischen Kreisen kommende Kritik richtet ihre verbalen Angriffe allzu häufig gegen eine nebulöse, schlecht definierte Zivilisation. Gewiss klingt „Für die Zerstörung der Zivilisation“ radikal. Meiner eigenen Definition gemäß stimme ich damit sogar überein. Aber meiner Definition nach ist Zivilisation nicht irgendeine nebulöse, weitestgehend mentale Kategorie, die dem Rationalismus oder dem westlichen Denken oder welcher unerwünschten Denkweise auch immer entspringt; sie ist ein Netzwerk konkreter sozialer Institutionen, die ich in meinem Alltag konfrontiere: Staat, Wirtschaft, Religion, die Familie, technologische Systeme, und so weiter, allesamt sehr reale Entitäten, die nicht von Gedankenspielen beseitigt werden werden.

Und genau hier tappt die derzeitige Tendenz in eine Falle. Wenn eine Analyse des institutionellen Rahmens der Unterdrückung, Ausbeutung, Herrschaft und Entfremdung vergessen wird, dann tritt Therapie an die Stelle von Revolution. Wir sind dann gezwungen, uns mit den pathetischen, weinerlichen Geständnissen eines Chris Crass zu beschäftigen oder auch der schlechten Popkultur-Psychologie der Autor*innen des Textes „Stick it to the Manarchy“ (wobei schon der Gebrauch eines Begriffs wie „manarchy“ ein sicheres Zeichen dafür ist, dass jemand nichts hörenswertes zu sagen hat), die versuchen ihren „Sexismus“, „Rassismus“, „Homophobie“ und „Klassismus“ abzulegen, die nicht länger irgendwelche Ideologien der Bigotterie sind, sondern niedere mentale Krankheiten, unter denen die selbsternannten „Privilegierten“ aller Klassen leiden.

Jede*r ernsthafte revolutionäre Anarchist*in muss sehen, dass das nur eine weitere List der Feiglinge und jener ist, die ein Interesse an der Aufrechterhaltung der herrschenden Ordnung haben, die eigentliche Entscheidung darüber, auf wessen Seite sie im Kampf gegen diese Gesellschaft stehen, aufzuschieben. Diejenigen von uns, die es mit der Zerstörung der gegenwärtigen Welt ernst meinen, um unsere Leben selbst zu gestalten, haben keine Zeit für diese selbstgerechten Gedankenspielereien, die so sehr an Selbsthilfegruppen erinnern („Mein Name ist … …

author: 张皓翔
title: The Dislocation of Vendémiaire—A Commentary on the European Movement Centered on France from September to October 2026
content: From September to October 2026, a movement centered on France provided us with an excellent window for observing the communist cause in the 21st century and also triggered widespread public discussion. Previously, in the form of four separate commentary articles, we published them successively on the libcom platform, unfolding one by one as the movement progressed. These four pieces are not independent theoretical expositions; rather, they develop within the whole theoretical system represented by The Shackles of the Elements, Dance a Dance of Roses on the Land of Rhodes, and The Contemporary Dimensional Ascension of Capital. Now we have found the opportunity to combine them into one volume and add some notes. This is also the first time we have taken theory out of the study and put it to trial on the real field of movement.

 Сегодня революционная борьба страдает от недостатка способностей на индивидуальном, организационном и социальном уровнях. Нашим крупнейшим социальным движениям, как и нашим самым страстным индивидуальным усилиям необходим милитантский импульс, способный стратегически соединять разрозненные действия. Милитантность позволяет массовым движениям испытывать обоснованную гордость и ощущать свою причастность к наиболее успешным революционным действиям. Она также даёт активному меньшинству чёткую цель и место в формировании социальной силы. Однако стойкая милитантность — это акт свободы, но сегодня большинство людей оказываются «втянуты» в неё не из сознательного выбора, а в силу обстоятельств. Мы, люди, борющиеся за социальную революцию, хотим иметь возможность самим решать, как развивать нашу милитантность. Мы требуем возможности сознательно участвовать в милитантской практике, поскольку так революционный потенциал наших движений будет обеспечен свободой людей.


 И всё же, даже при наличии свободы выбрать милитантскую деятельность остаётся вопрос:


 Куда революционерам направить свои усилия, чтобы их деятельность была связана с той реальностью, в которой в конечном счёте будет жить народ, пробуждала в людях чувство субъектности в Истории и принятие ответственности за этичность своих действий в настоящем?


 Наш ответ следует искать во взрослом образовании, которое представляет собой особенно благоприятную почву для долгосрочного участия в судьбе народных движений. Людям всегда будет необходимо учиться. Поэтому мы предлагаем создать, поддерживать и защищать революционное образовательное направление, которое станет местом встречи и обмена опытом для людей, стремящихся учиться и учить других, — в том числе членов сообщества, активистов, организаторов, диссидентов и милитантов.


 Стремление учиться, которое обычно связывают с молодёжью, новичками, студентами и теми, кому недостаёт опыта, не следует отвергать как стихийную форму организации. Нередко люди, «научившись», переходят к «действиям»: применяют полученные знания, но покидают пространство обучения, в котором они развивали свои способности, не заботясь о том, чтобы сохранить прочную связь с его методами и целями.


 Однако мы настаиваем на том, что это пространство нуждается в целенаправленной защите, если оно должно оказывать долговременное влияние на социальные преобразования. Прежде всего, защита этого пространства со временем будет способствовать коллективному становлению милитантов, которые смогут использовать общий образовательный опыт как основу для единой стратегии и политической программы. Кроме того, сохранение этого пространства будет способствовать пониманию значимости милитантов в социальной борьбе и осознанию того, насколько милитантность необходима для успеха революционных движений.


 Стремление учиться должно выполнять две функции: с одной стороны, служить пространством, где люди получают инструменты и обретают сообщество, необходимые для становления милитантами; с другой — знакомить более широкое сообщество с понятием милитантности и её теорией. Таким образом, наша цель едина, но включает два самостоятельных аспекта, которые необходимо развивать одновременно:


 Мы должны создать образовательное пространство для становления милитантов, а наше регулярное участие в его жизни должно обеспечивать надёжные пути как к милитантской деятельности, так и обратно — к образованию.


 Таким образом, стремление учиться станет пространством, где люди с большим и меньшим опытом смогут встречаться и учиться друг у друга.


 При столь ясных целях нас, несомненно, будут оценивать по нашим же критериям — приверженности делу и стойкости. Ясное определение того, что представляет собой стремление учиться, сможет воплотиться в жизнь лишь благодаря нашей приверженности ему, а его эффективность можно будет оценить лишь по тому, насколько долго оно сохраняется и насколько верно остаётся своим целям.

En svensk förf. Fredrik Lindholm, har någon gång år 1909 "gjort" en skrift om anarkismen, vari han åtagit sig att framställa anarkismens uppgifter. Skriftens huvudsakliga innehåll har blivit ett upprepande av de kungamord och tsarmord, som anarkisterna anklagats för, och i vissa fall väl även utfört.

Den omfattar en period då despotismen, liksom nu i många länder, intog högsätet, då folket var helt rättslöst, då anarkisterna och andra motståndare till stats- och utsugningsmonopolen, behandlades som förbrytare och fördrevs ur landet. Ofta fanns det blott en utväg att väcka uppmärksamhet för dessa ohyggliga förhållanden: Bombens detonation.

Bomben var avsedd eller träffade en herre som i sitt dagliga liv, kanske tanklöst, undertecknat hundratals dödsdomar och förvisningar, som framställde sig vara i kompani med gud, innehade kontroll över alla kanaler till det existerande rättsväsendet, befallde över polis och militär, följaktligen utövade ensam härskarmakt eller representerande sådan makt.

Jag anser mig inte i detta sammanhang ha någon befogenhet att diskutera huruvida det var rätt eller inte. Det skulle bli en alltför vidlyftig avhandling, att framställa vad man talar för och emot i ett sammanhang som detta. Våldet har alltid karaktäriserats som ultima ratio, en sista utväg.

I anarkismens politiska och sociala tankevärld har våldet ingen plats. Såväl de politiska som sociala uttrycksformerna skapar en miljö och atmosfär, som avlägsnar ifrån våldet och främjar inbördes hjälp. Dessa förändringar bygger anarkisterna inte på en sinnets förändring som grundlag, men på fakta som att möjligheterna för det sociala välståndets fördelning uppnåtts och herraväldets och förtryckets förverkligande avlägsnats.

Den fulländning som anarkismens samhällsideal företräder bygger på orsakernas upphävande, orsakerna till våldsmentaliteten.

De invändningar som göras, bygga på helt andra förutsättningar. Den ägande som fruktar för att tjuvar och rånare skola tillägna sig hans egendom, vinkar indignerat bort pratet om att våldet skulle bli överflödigt, noggrant förbiseende att människorna under kommunistiskt-anarkistiska samhällsformer inte ha någon anledning att stjäla eller med våld försvara sig mot stöld.

Militären, som tränat in sin yrkesmentalitet och den fanatiske chauvinisten komma med sina argument! Skola vi inte försvara oss mot utländska fiender?

Här är en fråga som redan nuet borde taga klar ställning till. Finns det någon mening i att försvara sig mot utländska fiender? Vad är det man kan och vill försvara? Marken, naturen, sjöarna, kan inte försvaras, kan inte erövras. Under ett krig kan man däremot förstöra dem. Ja, måste förstöra. Fransmän och belgare förstörde stora delar av sina egna områden, direkt, när tyskarna trängde fram under världskriget, förstörde för att inte tyskarna skulle få nytta av det. Franska och belgiska sprängämnen och volymkulor träffade fransk och belgisk natur - och förstörde kanske lika mycket som "fienden", tyskarna, förstörde.

Krigets mekanisering är ett kapitel som vilar tungt på vågen när det gäller att mäta våldets uppgift i nuet. Förr, när en hord människor dreva mot varandra med pikar och muskedunder, var det hela ett farligt äventyr, som begränsades av vapnens räckvidd. Nu finnes det inte längre någon sådan begränsning. Brand-, gift- och spränggaser ha förverkat varje tanke på "försvar" och mobiliserat angreppstanken som enda möjlighet i en våldskonflikt mellan staterna. De långskjutande kanonerna understryka denna utveckling. Ett krig blir blott ett fruktansvärt förgörande av allt levande.

Enda synpunkten som talar för att med krigets våld lösa de mellanfolkliga konflikterna, är den, att vapenfabrikerna och sprängämnestillverkarna behöva experimentera och måste ha stora dividender.

¿QUÉ es el patriotismo? ¿Es el amor por el lugar donde uno nació, el lugar de los recuerdos y las esperanzas de la infancia, de los sueños y las aspiraciones? ¿Es el lugar donde, con ingenuidad infantil, contemplábamos las nubes fugaces y nos preguntábamos por qué nosotros tampoco podíamos correr tan rápido? ¿El lugar donde contábamos los miles de millones de estrellas centelleantes, aterrorizados ante la idea de que cada una de ellas fuera «un ojo» que traspasara lo más profundo de nuestras pequeñas almas? ¿Es el lugar donde escuchábamos el canto de los pájaros y anhelábamos tener alas para volar, como ellos, hacia tierras lejanas? ¿O el lugar donde nos sentábamos a los pies de nuestra madre, embelesados por maravillosos relatos de grandes hazañas y conquistas? En resumen, ¿es el amor por ese lugar, donde cada pulgada representa recuerdos queridos y preciosos de una infancia feliz, alegre y juguetona?

Si eso fuera patriotismo, pocos hombres estadounidenses de hoy en día podrían considerarse patriotas, ya que el lugar de juego se ha convertido en fábrica, molino y mina, mientras que los sonidos ensordecedores de la maquinaria han sustituido a la música de los pájaros. Tampoco podemos ya escuchar las historias de grandes hazañas, pues las que cuentan hoy nuestras madres no son más que historias de dolor, lágrimas y aflicción.

¿Qué es, entonces, el patriotismo? «El patriotismo, señor, es el último recurso de los sinvergüenzas», dijo el Dr. Johnson. León Tolstói, el mayor antipatriota de nuestro tiempo, define el patriotismo como el principio que justifica la formación de asesinos en masa; un oficio que requiere mejor equipamiento para el ejercicio del asesinato que para la fabricación de artículos de primera necesidad como zapatos, ropa y viviendas; un oficio que garantiza mejores beneficios y mayor gloria que el del trabajador medio.

Gustave Hervé [1], otro gran antipatriota, califica acertadamente el patriotismo de superstición —una mucho más perjudicial, brutal e inhumana que la religión—. La superstición de la religión tuvo su origen en la incapacidad del hombre para explicar los fenómenos naturales. Es decir, cuando el hombre primitivo oía un trueno o veía un relámpago, no podía dar una explicación a ninguno de ellos y, por lo tanto, concluía que detrás de ellos debía de haber una fuerza mayor que él mismo. Del mismo modo, veía una fuerza sobrenatural en la lluvia y en los diversos cambios que se producen en la naturaleza. El patriotismo, por el contrario, es una superstición creada artificialmente y mantenida a través de una red de mentiras y falsedades; una superstición que despoja al hombre de su autoestima y dignidad, y aumenta su arrogancia y vanidad.

De hecho, la vanidad, la arrogancia y el egoísmo son los elementos esenciales del patriotismo. Permítanme ilustrarlo. El patriotismo parte de la base de que nuestro planeta está dividido en pequeños rincones, cada uno rodeado por una verja de hierro. Quienes han tenido la suerte de nacer en un rincón concreto se consideran mejores, más nobles, más grandiosos y más inteligentes que los seres vivos que habitan en cualquier otro rincón. Por lo tanto, es deber de todo aquel que vive en ese rincón elegido luchar, matar y morir en el intento de imponer su superioridad sobre todos los demás.

author: Unknown
title: We Have Fed You All for a Thousand Years
content:
Title

: We Have Fed You All for a Thousand Years

Subtitle

: Travels of a Protest Poem

Source

: KSL: Bulletin of the Kate Sharpley Library No. 122, October 2026


A Humble Reminder : To the Propertied Classes


 (Slightly altered from Rudyard Kipling’s Ode in praise of English Enterprise.)


 We have fed you all for a thousand years,

 And you hail us still unfed,

 Though there’s never a pound of all your pounds

 But marks the workers’ dead;

 We have yielded our best to give you rest,

 And you lie on a crimson wool,

 For if blood be the price of England’s wealth,

 Good God, we ha’ paid in full.


 There’s never a mine blown skyward now

 But we’re buried alive for you;

 There’s never a wreck drifts shoreward now

 But it’s we are the ghastly crew;

 Go, reckon our dead by the forges red,

 And the factories where we spin;

 If blood be the price of England’s wealth,

 Good God, we ha’ paid it in.


 We have fed you all for a thousand years,

 For that was our doom, you know,

 From the days when you chained us in your fields

 To the strike of a week ago;

 You have eaten our lives and our babes and wives,

 And we’re told it’s your legal share;

 But if blood be the price of England’s wealth,

 Good God, we ha’ bought it fair.


 N.


 


 In September 1893 the London anarchist newspaper

Freedom : A Journal of Anarchist Communism

 published a poem called ‘A Humble Reminder : To the Propertied Classes’, credited to ‘N.’

[1]

 It’s an anti-capitalist protest, lamenting the ‘workers’ dead’ whose deaths enriched those ‘propertied classes’. It rails at the rich ‘We have fed you all for a thousand years, / And you hail us still unfed’. I do not know who ‘N.’ was, though they seem to be connected to the

Freedom

 milieu.

Freedom

 had published another poem by them, ‘The Pet Voter’, in August 1892.

[2]

 Max Nettlau used the same initial when writing in

Freedom

 in June 1891; the Fabian socialist Edith Nesbit had a poem ‘A Word For The Children’ in

Freedom

 in February 1891 (‘The right to give help is your own, / The right to claim it theirs.’) Neither seems a convincing candidate for the authorship of this poem.


The Kipling connection


 ‘N.’ introduced their poem by saying it was ‘slightly altered from Rudyard Kipling’s Ode in praise of English Enterprise.’ That’s a reference to Kipling’s ‘Song of the Dead’ published four months earlier in

The English Illustrated Magazine

 (May 1893). ‘N.’s address to the propertied classes ‘For if blood be the price of England’s wealth, / Good God, we ha’ paid in full’ rewrites Kipling’s address to the sea ‘If blood be the price of admiralty, / Lord God, we ha’ paid in full!’.

[3]

 The ‘Humble Reminder’ changes Kipling’s poem – but leans heavily upon it. Mark Leier said ‘strictly speaking the poem is not a parody of Kipling’s poem but a re-working of the words based on the original verse and meter.’

[4]

 It reminds me of Utah Philips’ comment on IWW songmaking: ‘The Wobblies liked to steal the hymn tunes ‘cos they were pretty and change the words so they made more sense.’

[5]


 The connection to Kipling persisted. He was credited in many of the reprints (inevitable, perhaps, given that the author remained unknown and their debt to Kipling was clear). There were even articles discussing what it would mean if the poem were by Kipling.

[6]


Reprinted and recited


 Once printed, it was always possible for the poem to reappear, and this one spread beyond the anarchist press, becoming a standard of labour movement papers. The title often changed, varying from ‘The Cry of Toil’ to ‘The Capitalist’. Just as the connection to Kipling is sometimes there and sometimes not, the text varies between the poetic ‘ha’’ to the everyday ‘have’.


 Apparently a version was published in Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania in 1895.

[7]

 The Portland anarchist newspaper

The Firebrand

 reprinted the poem (anonymously) as ‘The Workers Outcry’ in 1897.

[8]

 Changes had been made to Americanise the text: instead of pounds the third line talks of ‘there’s never a dollar of all your wealth’.


 Sometimes you can read about the poem’s life off the printed page. In May 1897 Miss Olive Keep recited ‘We have fed you all for a thousand years’ at a gathering of the Socialist Labor Party.

[9]

. In August 1899,

The Carpenter

, a union journal for ‘Carpenters, Stair Builders, Machine Wood Workers, Planing Mill Men, and Kindred Interests’ reprinted the ‘Firebrand version’ (with credit) …

content:

Es drängt uns, eine Frage von eminenter Wichtigkeit und folgenschwerer Bedeutung unter das Secirmesser der Kritik zu bringen, die Organisationsfrage nämlich. Es ist dieser Gegenstand von weit grösserer Wichtigkeit und Tragweite, als es bei einer flüchtigen Betrachtung den Schein haben mag: denn die Organisation ist das wichtigste Werkzeug des obschwebenden geistigen Riesenkampfes, und ist von grosser Wichtigkeit, ob eben dieses Instrument scharf und spitzig oder schartig und stumpf ist: die Organisation kann aber auch, wenn sie tauglich geformt wird, zur wirksamen Triebkraft, zum zweckdienlichen Sauerteige für die künftige Kulturform werden, sowie andererseits zum Geiste, der beschworen wurde und sich nicht zähmen lässt, wie der von Goethe’s Zauberlehrling.

Dem Wesen nach unterscheiden wir zwei Systeme der Organisation, und zwar den Centralismus und den Föderalismus. Beide sollen nun untersucht werden.

Was zunächst den Centralismus anbelangt, so ist derselbe nichts Anderes wie ein misslungener Abklatsch des despotischen oder absoluten Regierungssystems und zeigt uns, dass nicht allein der Affe, sondern auch der Mensch den Nachahmungstrieb besitzt.

Die Despotie zeigt uns den Centralismus in seiner vollendetsten und ausgebildetsten Form.

Caligula und Nero, Philipp der Zweite von Spanien und Richard III. von England, sowie Ludwig XI. von Frankreich: sie Alle waren Centralisten, die unser Augenmerk fesseln, denn sie waren gross, wenn auch als Tyrannen, wenn auch im Schlechten, sie ragen über die Mittelmässigkeit hoch empor: sie waren Verbrecher an der Menschenwürde, aber sie waren es voll Kraft und Mut, voll Kühnheit und Energie. Was sind aber die Tyrännchen, die sich die Arbeiter durch den Centralismus erzeugen, indem sie sich von Mauldreschern bethören lassen? Erbärmliche Jammergestalten im Vergleiche mit jenen Titanen, deren Andenken glühenden Hass in unserer Seele weckt? Sie sind armselige Zwerge, Liliputaner, und thun wohl daran, sich spreizen und viel und laut von der Redner-Tribüne herunter zu deklamiren und zu kreischen, denn sonst würde man sie gar nicht wahrnehmen. Sie zu verachten, wäre zu viel Ehre für sie, nein, ein mitleidiges Bedauern ist Alles, was ihnen zugewendet werden kann. Sie sind der Vergessenheit geweiht und haben dereinst zwecklos gelebt: das alleinige Ziel ihres Strebens ist das Wohlleben, und dafür treten sie das Heiligste, Erhabenste, die himmlische, ewige Idee in den Kot: sie unterscheiden sich in nichts von einem Mastschwein, das auf nichts denkt wie auf vielen und guten Mais und einen trefflichen Stall, nur erstreben sie beides in einer anderen Form. Ärmliche, kleinliche Menschlein! – Und sie wären vielleicht fähig, ihr ephemeres Sein an die ewige unvergängliche Kette von Ursachen und Wirkungen, Grund und Folge zu knüpfen und ewig zu sein im Erlösungswerk der Menschheit durch ihr fruchtbringendes Wirken, sie wären vielleicht befähigt zu schaffen, so dass sie darin das reinste Glück, ein Gefühl von Seligkeit empfänden im Glücke und Paradieses-Sein Aller, dass sie für künftige Generationen anzubahnen helfen würden.

Der Centralismus vernichtet die individuelle Selbstständigkeit und Freiheit vollständig, wie wir es im despotischen Staat antreffen. Hier ist der Wille des Autokraten Gesetz, dort der Wille des Parteigötzen, den man auf das Piedestal emporhob: der Druck ist ärger noch als im despotischen Staat, denn in einem solchen soll nur eine gesetzwidrige Handlung gerichtet werden; die Spitze der centralistischen Pyramide aber richtet nicht allein die Handlungen, sondern sogar die Meinungen, sie erforscht Herz und Nieren der Menschen wie Jehova, und es sollte auch der Wille solcher Parteigötzen unter Donner und Blitz zeitweilig verkündet werden, wenigstens hätte das Colophonium stärkeren Absatz und die Spängler fänden bei der Anfertigung von Donnerblechen vielleicht lohnende Arbeit.

Treffend bezeichnet ein Engländer den Centralismus, indem er sagt: “Stelle ein Schaf vor die andern und Du hast die Herde fertig.” Ja wohl, eine Herde ist es und weiter nichts, und diese Herde geht hin, wohin der Hammel sie führt, und wenn er in einen Sumpf hineinplumpst, so wandern Alle in den Morast, und thatsächlich stecken gegenwärtig die Bekenner der alleinseligmachenden Sozialdemokratie mit ihrer achtundvierziger Theorie im Schlamme der Reformpolitik und leiden an …

author: rezgar2
title: نحو أممية يسارية رقمية في مواجهة الرأسمالية الرقمية، اليسار الرقمي في زمن الخوارزميات
content:
إن المعركة حول التكنولوجيا هي أيضاً معركة حول الملكية والسلطة والوعي ومستقبل البشرية. ومع اتساع دور الفضاء الرقمي بوصفه إحدى الساحات الرئيسية للصراع الطبقي، يمكن للأممية اليسارية الرقمية أن تصبح نقطة انطلاق لتجديد العمل الأممي عموماً. ويتمثل التحدي اليوم في البناء على التشخيص بأدوات جماعية للمواجهة، وفي تطوير التعاون العملي القائم بين قوى اليسار وتوسيعه، ليكمل المواقف والبيانات التضامنية بعمل مشترك أكثر تنظيماً واستمرارية، وفي التوجه التدريجي من منصات الاحتكارات إلى بدائل مستقلة وديمقراطية. وبذلك يمكن أن تتحول إمكانات الثورة الرقمية من امتياز تستأثر به حفنة من الشركات والدول الكبرى إلى مكسب عام يخدم الإنسان وتحرره.

صدر حديثاً كتاب «نحو أممية يسارية رقمية في مواجهة الرأسمالية الرقمية، اليسار الرقمي في زمن الخوارزميات» نصوص ودراسات وبرنامج عمل حول اليسار الرقمي والأممية اليسارية الرقمية، من إعدادي وتأليفي، وهو متاح إلكترونياً ومجاناً.

يشهد العالم ثورة رقمية متسارعة تعيد تشكيل الاقتصاد والعمل والسياسة والوعي الإنساني. وفي الوقت الذي تفتح فيه هذه الثورة إمكانات هائلة للتقدم والتحرر البشري وتجاوز الفقر والأمراض، تتركز ملكية أدواتها ومواردها الأساسية في أيدي حفنة من الاحتكارات الرأسمالية المدعومة من الدول الكبرى. وفي المقابل، تتسع الاحتجاجات الجماهيرية والشبابية في كثير من بلدان العالم، مستفيدة من الأدوات الرقمية في التنظيم والتعبئة، ومؤكدة أن الظروف الموضوعية لتجاوز الرأسمالية قائمة.

ومن هذا التناقض تنبع الحاجة إلى مسار متكامل يبدأ بفهم الرأسمالية الرقمية، ويمر بإغناء تجربة اليسار فكرياً وتنظيمياً بما يواكب التطورات الراهنة، وصولاً إلى بناء أممية يسارية رقمية قادرة على التأثير.

تتيح الثورة الرقمية تقليص ساعات العمل، وتطوير الخدمات الصحية والتعليمية، وتحرير الإنسان من الأعمال المرهقة والمتكررة. غير أن هذه الإمكانات تتطور في إطار علاقات إنتاج رأسمالية، تستحوذ فيها الاحتكارات على القسم الأكبر من مكاسب التقدم التكنولوجي.

فالخوارزميات والمنصات الرقمية ليست محايدة اجتماعياً أو طبقياً، إذ تتأثر بعلاقات الملكية والتمويل والإدارة. وتتجاوز هذه الهيمنة حدود الاقتصاد إلى تشكيل الوعي وتوسيع المراقبة وتوظيف التكنولوجيا في القتل والحروب، ويزيد تقارب بعض قوى اليمين المتطرف مع الاحتكارات التكنولوجية من مخاطر الفاشية الرقمية.

وأمام هذا الواقع، يبرز السؤال الجوهري: كيف يقاوم اليسار الرأسمالية في طورها الرقمي المتقدم، ويفتح الطريق نحو بديل اشتراكي إنساني أكثر عدلاً، محلياً وعالمياً؟ وكيف يجدد نفسه ويطورها ليكون قادراً على ذلك؟

فقد أصبحت الرأسمالية الرقمية قوة عابرة للحدود، بينما يبقى جزء كبير من العمل اليساري الرقمي محصوراً داخل الأطر الوطنية، ويعاني ضعف التنسيق الرقمي الأممي. وتكشف التجارب الحديثة حجم الخطر الذي يواجهه اليسار في هذا الميدان.

ففي البرازيل، وخلال سباق رئاسي بالغ التقارب عام 2026 بين لولا دا سيلفا ومرشح اليمين المتطرف فلافيو بولسونارو، اتهم لولا وحزبه شركة ميتا بتقليص انتشار منشوراته لمصلحة خصمه. وتدخلت المحكمة الانتخابية العليا وألزمت الشركة بتقديم توضيحات، ونشرت صحيفة «فولها دي ساو باولو» مراسلات داخلية يقر فيها موظفون في الشركة بأن قيود المنصة أضرت بحسابات لولا، فيما تحدثت ميتا عن «أعطال تقنية». ورغم ذلك، حسمت التعبئة الجماهيرية جولة الإعادة لصالح لولا.

وفي ألمانيا، وظّف إيلون ماسك منصته «إكس» لدعم حزب «البديل من أجل ألمانيا» اليميني المتطرف قبيل انتخابات فبراير 2025، عبر مقالات التأييد وبثّ حوار مباشر مع زعيمته أليس فايدل، فيما رصدت دراسات انحياز خوارزميات المنصة لصالح محتوى الحزب. وفي كولومبيا، وبعد جولة إعادة حسمت لمرشح اليمين المتطرف بفارق نحو نقطة مئوية واحدة، اتهم الرئيس غوستافو بيترو شركة سايبر إسرائيلية بنشر نصف مليون حساب آلي زائف للتلاعب بالناخبين، وطعن في سلامة برمجيات الفرز وانحياز المنصات الرقمية لليمين المتطرف. ومهما انتهى إليه التحقيق، فإن انتقال الطعن في انتخابات بلد بأكمله إلى ميدان الخوارزميات والحسابات الآلية يكشف طبيعة المرحلة التي نعيشها.

أما المثال الأوضح فجاء من المحكمة الجنائية الدولية. فبعد أن أصدر قضاتها مذكرات توقيف بحق مسؤولين إسرائيليين بتهم ارتكاب جرائم حرب في غزة، فرضت الإدارة الأمريكية عقوبات على عدد من قضاتها ومسؤوليها، فأغلقت شركات أمريكية حساباتهم المصرفية والرقمية. وإذا كانت الرأسمالية مستعدة لفعل ذلك بمحكمة دولية تضم أكثر من مئة وعشرين دولة عضواً، فماذا ستفعل بمشروع يساري يصبح مؤثراً ويسعى إلى كسر هيمنتها، ويتجاوز الخطوط الحمراء التي رسمتها؟

وتمتد هذه الهيمنة إلى الحياة اليومية للناشطات والناشطين، عبر عقوبات رقمية تفرضها المنصات على من يفضح جرائم الحرب الإسرائيلية وانتهاكات دول أخرى، أو يطرح خطاباً يسارياً جذرياً. وتبدأ هذه العقوبات بالتضييق وتقليص الانتشار والتهميش، وتصل إلى حذف المحتوى وإغلاق الحسابات. وقد وثقت منظمات حقوق الإنسان الدولية هذه الممارسات وأدانتها، ومنها تقرير «هيومن رايتس ووتش» عن الرقابة الممنهجة على المحتوى الفلسطيني في منصات ميتا. ويدفع هذا القمع الرقمي كثيراً من الناشطات والناشطين إلى رقابة ذاتية طوعية، فيعدلون خطابهم ويتجنبون قضايا بعينها خوفاً من الحظر …

title: Antimilitarismus und Revolution
content:
